websites.name: Aura Core Digital
websites.niche: Digital Marketing Agency (SEO, web design, branding)
websites.brandVoice: professional, confident, friendly, no fluff or filler sentences

backlink.placementRule: Insert the link naturally ONE time, inside the body (not the intro sentence, not the heading, not the last sentence). It must read as a genuine reference, never forced or salesy.

article.tone: informative, SEO-optimized, written for a blog reader
article.structure: Catchy title, short intro (2-3 sentences), 3-5 H2 sections, short conclusion with a soft CTA
article.extraRules: Include one H2 with a numbered or bulleted list. Use the target keywords naturally, do not stuff them.

guestPost.tone: authoritative, written as an outside industry expert, not promotional
guestPost.structure: Title, intro, 3 H2 sections, then a 2-sentence author bio paragraph at the very end
guestPost.extraRules: Must NOT sound like the agency talking about itself — write as a neutral expert contributing value to the host site's audience.

web2.structure: Short catchy title, 2-3 short paragraphs, no headings needed
web2.extraRules: Place the backlink within the first paragraph. Keep sentences short and skimmable — this is for Blogger/WordPress.com/Medium style posts.

profileBacklink.structure: One short paragraph — like a forum, directory, or community 'About Me' bio
profileBacklink.extraRules: Mention the niche naturally, work in the backlink once. Should read like a genuine profile bio, never like an ad.

pdfSubmission.tone: informative, structured like a downloadable guide/resource
pdfSubmission.structure: Title, short intro, 3-4 sections with subheadings, closing 'Resources' section
pdfSubmission.extraRules: End with a short 'Resources' or 'About the Author' section that naturally includes the backlink — this text will be turned into a PDF.

imageSubmission.structure: Image title, ALT text suggestion, 2-3 sentence caption/description
imageSubmission.extraRules: Provide the ALT text separately, then a short caption that naturally mentions the brand/backlink context (not the raw URL).

articleSubmission.tone: neutral, informative, written for article-directory audiences
articleSubmission.structure: Title, intro, 3 H2 sections, closing 'Author Resource Box' paragraph
articleSubmission.extraRules: The Resource Box paragraph at the end must contain the backlink — this is standard for article directory submissions.
